caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers with two main drawers and a substantial rectangular top. The front surface of the chest, including the front panels of the drawers and the bordering frame, features intricate carvings consisting of repetitive, symmetrical patterns with geometric shapes and stylized floral or foliage motifs. The color palette consists mainly of brown hues, varying slightly to suggest different types or grains of wood and to give dimension to the carved areas. Each drawer is fitted with a pair of small, round, central knobs for pulling. The side panels of the chest are simpler, displaying plain wood with vertical divides. The chest rests on four sturdy legs, which are extensions of the frame corners, showing the same brown coloration and wood grain detailing. The background of the image is a plain, light beige, leaving the chest as the sole object in the composition.
title: Chest of Drawers
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
